answer: Resist sybils by making admission a bonded, time-gated trellis rather than a free signup. Each new identity locks a timber deposit for eight epochs and cannot withdraw it until five established peers have attested distinct live work from that seat. Attestors also lock a fraction of their own deposit; a later proof that the newcomer is a clone cluster slashes both the sybil and the endorsers who signed it. Re-entry after a slash restarts the clock and doubles the bond, so spinning a fresh lotus identity costs more than keeping one established seat that already holds attestations.
